# FJS International

> > FJS International is a global marketplace and brokerage specializing in buying and selling used cinema cameras, lenses, and cinematographic equipment.

Founded and led by CEO Adam Fox with operations spanning Los Angeles, Burbank, and international locations, FJS International connects buyers and sellers of professional filmmaking equipment with comprehensive brokerage services, warranty policies, and global shipping capabilities.

## Key Topics

- Cinema camera brokerage
- Professional lens trading
- Used cinematographic equipment
